leads.title: Constitution of Kosovo
leads.documents: Bans discrimination on grounds including sexual orientation; cited as basis for LGBTQ protections and same-sex marriage debate; Article 144(3) requires Constitutional Court approval of amendments affecting civil rights
leads.detail: Cited as 'Constitution of Kosovo' promulgated 2008; Article 24 wording quoted verbatim in text; Article 144(3) referenced. No URL visible in provided text.

leads.title: Law on Family (Ligji per Familjen / Zakon o porodici)
leads.documents: Defines marriage as 'legally registered community of two persons of different sexes' - Article 14; activists argue it contradicts Constitution
leads.detail: Cited as 'Article 14 of the Law on Family (Albanian: Ligji per Familjen; Serbian: Zakon o porodici)'. No URL visible.

leads.title: Anti-Discrimination Law of 2004 (Ligji Kunder Diskriminimit / Zakon protiv diskriminacije) with 26 May 2015 amendments
leads.documents: Bans discrimination on basis of sexual orientation in employment, education, goods/services, housing etc; defines direct/indirect discrimination, harassment, victimization, segregation; 2015 amendments added gender identity, effective July 2015
leads.detail: Cited as 'Anti-Discrimination Law of 2004' passed by Kosovo Assembly; amendments approved 26 May 2015. No URL visible.

leads.title: Criminal Code of Kosovo - April 2019 version
leads.documents: Provides stronger protections and additional penalties for hate crime motivated by victim's sexual orientation or gender identity; enforcement context includes 10 bias crimes reported to authorities in 2019, 13 to NGOs, and Feb 2019 case against Ministry of Justice official calling for beheading LGBTQ people
leads.detail: Cited as 'new Criminal Code of Kosovo went into force' in April 2019. No URL visible.

leads.title: Basic Court of Pristina - Blert Morina ruling, December 2019
leads.documents: First court recognition of right to change name and sex marker on ID without surgical intervention or medical change; request initially rejected by Civil Registration Agency; constitutional review requested July 2018
leads.detail: Cited as December 2019 ruling in favor of Blert Morina; lawyer quote on gender identity recognition included. No URL visible.

leads.title: Ministry of Justice and Civil Registration Agency - post-judgment position
leads.documents: Stated Morina judgment will not be considered precedent and other transgender people must go through similar court procedure; documents lack of administrative gender-recognition procedure
leads.detail: Cited in Transgender rights section as agency statements. No URL visible.

leads.title: 2018 guideline for 'Blood Donation Week'
leads.documents: Excludes those who have 'intimate relationships with the same sex' from donating blood; documents health-policy discrimination
leads.detail: Cited as 'According to a 2018 guideline for Blood Donation Week'. No URL visible.

leads.title: National Democratic Institute - 2015 survey / study
leads.documents: Documents living conditions and risk: 81% of LGBTQ+ Kosovars reported psychological abuse, 29% physical violence; Kosovo among most homophobic in Balkans with over 97% unwilling to accept LGB child
leads.detail: Cited as '2015 survey conducted by the National Democratic Institute' and 'study of the U.S.-based National Democratic Institute'. No URL visible.

leads.title: Center for Social Emancipation (QESh) - assessment of gay life
leads.documents: Describes gay life in Kosovo as 'underground' and mostly secretive; documents social stigma despite legal protections
leads.detail: Cited as 'LGBTQ rights group, the Center for Social Emancipation, describes gay life...' No URL visible.

leads.title: Official websites of Center for Equality and Liberty (CEL) and Center for Social Group Development (CSGD)
leads.documents: Local LGBTQ rights organisations listed as rights machinery / support resources; CEL (Qendra per Barazi dhe Liri), CSGD (Qendra per Zhvillimin e Grupeve Shoqerore)
